renderRules.github: GitHub Journey PR is the required MVP collaboration UI; render committed Markdown, tables, diffs, task lists and supported Mermaid natively
renderRules.markdown: canonical committed Markdown with tables, links, headings and code blocks; PR description and report comment are projections, not the source of truth
renderRules.mermaid: render natively in GitHub when the enterprise version/configuration supports it; VSIX displays safe source blocks as its optional local fallback
renderRules.frontMatter: render as a metadata summary, never as untrusted HTML
renderRules.refresh: GitHub updates on push/PR reload; optional VSIX watches the artifact path and workflow.json without model calls
renderRules.handoff: every report PR comment states the human decision now required, the next Agent after approval, and /resume-workflow <workflowId>
